## Summary

Describe the user-visible or internal change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the tests and manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and preserved existing user data and configuration behavior.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior where practical.
- [ ] I updated defaults, examples, compatibility notes, or user documentation where needed.
- [ ] I considered process lifecycle, path safety, storage/COW behavior, concurrency, and shutdown impact where relevant.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, forwarding secrets, private addresses, or generated runtime data.
